
{{alias}}( x )
    Computes the hyperbolic arccosecant of a single-precision floating-point
    number.

    If `x` is zero, the function returns positive or negative infinity,
    depending on the sign of `x`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Hyperbolic arccosecant.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    ~0.881
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0 )
    ~-0.881
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
